Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR rejects late plugin shared-state operations, drains accepted work, and stops retrying terminal shutdown errors. **Example:** A plugin finalizer looks up the key ready after SIGTERM begins Gateway shutdown. - **Before:** The lookup can enter retiring storage and terminal failures can consume three retry attempts. - **After:** The lookup receives STATE_DATABASE_READ_ADMISSION_INVALIDATED once while previously accepted operations drain. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | Useful lifecycle repair with focused reported regressions, blocked by an introduced static dependency cycle. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; it reports Node and Bun process regressions exercising late plugin refusal and clean SIGTERM and managed-restart exits, supported by the inspected process fixture. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Plugin background state work can continue into Gateway worker retirement and repeatedly retry failures that cannot recover. **Reason:** The linked repair explicitly reserved this follow-up, and the maintainer-authored PR preserves accepted work while refusing late operations. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this PR: it addresses a distinct shutdown bug, but its new storage imports introduce a dependency cycle that blocks the architecture check. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210` ## Before merge - [ ] **Break the storage-to-SDK-host import cycle (P2)** - Importing the SDK host here closes a static dependency cycle: openclaw-state-worker-store → legacy-sdk-resource-host → runtime/gateway-request-scope → gateway/server-methods/types → shared-types → config-revision-token → openclaw-state-worker-store. The architecture scanner includes type imports, so the type-only Gateway edges still count. The exact-head architecture check reports madge-import-cycles failed. The analogous new reader and lease imports also enter this graph. Expose host-owned admission through a leaf contract without importing the Gateway-coupled host implementation into storage. ## Findings - [P2] Break the storage-to-SDK-host import cycle — `src/state/openclaw-state-worker-store.ts:3`
Agent review details ### How this fits together Plugin state APIs reach resident namespace views, fixed readers, or shared worker leases; the SDK resource host coordinates their admission and completion with Gateway shutdown. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Plugin operation] --> B[SDK resource host] C[Gateway shutdown] --> B B --> D[Resident state views] B --> E[Fixed readers and worker leases] E --> F[Shared database] B --> G[Terminal refusal] G --> H[Retry classification] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep admission and drainage owned by the SDK host while exposing the storage-facing operation through an acyclic leaf contract. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? The base admits state operations without the new shutdown fence, and channel retry policy treats closed or unavailable errors as transient; linked repair evidence records matching red regressions. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The existing SDK host is the appropriate lifecycle owner, but importing its Gateway-coupled module from storage violates the repository's acyclic dependency gate. Full review comments: - [P2] Break the storage-to-SDK-host import cycle — `src/state/openclaw-state-worker-store.ts:3` Importing the SDK host here closes a static dependency cycle: openclaw-state-worker-store → legacy-sdk-resource-host → runtime/gateway-request-scope → gateway/server-methods/types → shared-types → config-revision-token → openclaw-state-worker-store. The architecture scanner includes type imports, so the type-only Gateway edges still count. The exact-head architecture check reports madge-import-cycles failed. The analogous new reader and lease imports also enter this graph. Expose host-owned admission through a leaf contract without importing the Gateway-coupled host implementation into storage. Confidence: 0.99 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.95 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [ece4ca85af0e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ece4ca85af0e0ffa7cc619522b9e8b7e40b08da9). ### Provenance checked - `SDK resource retention and drainage` keeps the original intent (05a2844d39c267707fac5257136c1f80e1ef9b46: Accepted plugin work must retain its supplying resources through completion and cleanup.) - `Retained shared-worker leases` keeps the original intent (19c6ef8d9e0260471b798615e8a1eaf42b9aada3: Worker-backed capture must drain admitted writes while retaining terminal cleanup ownership.) - `Plugin publication ordering and namespace views` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183844: Committed namespace views avoid repeated SQL reads while publication and live-authority checks remain authoritative.) - `Caller-controlled retry policy` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (d49acffa5e1a696a145eb71534fd7eee70a71412: The shared retry scheduler preserved caller-specific predicates and schedules; this PR explicitly makes terminal storage retirement override those predicates.) - `Nostr durable cursor recovery` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (7a35e243c4df6566d9bc715dec111d4dd0b9620c: Cursor recovery prevents progress beyond undurable ingress; transient recovery remains, while documented terminal shutdown refusals now stop it.) - `Gateway close entrypoints` keeps the original intent (b3260afd30a81054684634f3486fcd4c4e1f020c: Shutdown retains the actual SDK host through cleanup; the new wrapper preserves that host and removes only the initiating plugin invocation.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm check:madge-import-cycles - pnpm test src/plugin-state/plugin-state-worker.test.ts src/infra/retry-policy.test.ts src/llm/utils/retry.test.ts extensions/nostr/src/nostr-cursor.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - pnpm test src/state/dreaming-startup-admission.test.ts src/gateway/server-startup-lifetime.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=node node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 - OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=bun node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 What I checked: - **Introduced dependency cycle:** The added import closes this static cycle: state worker store → SDK resource host → Gateway request scope → server-method types → shared types → config revision projector → state worker store. ([`src/state/openclaw-state-worker-store.ts:3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210/src/state/openclaw-state-worker-store.ts#L3), [021cf2cab1cf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210)) - **Architecture failure matches source:** The exact-head check-guards-architecture check failed with the annotation madge-import-cycles failed. Its source scanner includes static import and export declarations, including type imports. ([`scripts/check-madge-import-cycles.ts:25`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210/scripts/check-madge-import-cycles.ts#L25), [021cf2cab1cf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210)) - **Distinct deferred repair:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188976 explicitly deferred plugin shared-state admission and terminal retry classification, identifying the late accepted lookup and repeated retry failures. ([c75a8a821e50](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c75a8a821e50ee3d4659a1b977f96d0ec9521574)) - **Accepted-work ownership:** The existing SDK host now tracks state operations and permits nested acquisition only while the admitted operation remains active; completion disables inherited admission. ([`src/plugins/legacy-sdk-resource-host.ts:68`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210/src/plugins/legacy-sdk-resource-host.ts#L68), [021cf2cab1cf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210)) - **Process regression coverage:** The existing isolated Gateway process scenario adds a plugin lookup during shutdown and asserts one terminal refusal, exit 0, and no worker-retirement or plugin-state-open diagnostics; the body reports Node and Bun passes. ([`test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts:644`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210/test/gateway-restart-resume.e2e.test.ts#L644), [021cf2cab1cf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/021cf2cab1cfebf15249e7bddd84573f430fb210)) - **Current main still lacks this repair:** Fetched main retains the unfenced SDK host and retry adapter without terminal state-admission classification. ([`src/infra/retry.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ece4ca85af0e0ffa7cc619522b9e8b7e40b08da9/src/infra/retry.ts), [ece4ca85af0e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ece4ca85af0e0ffa7cc619522b9e8b7e40b08da9)) ### PR surface Source +128, Tests +27, Docs +7.
